forbidden: learning a policy for a task whose sentence already determines the action
replacing a live reading with a stored procedure
calling a stored procedure 'permanent knowledge' before a held-out verdict admits it
required: the gap named before anything is acquired
admission against a held-out instance, not against the demonstration
rule.rule: READ first, always. Acquire a policy only for a gap the reading NAMED. Never store a policy for a task the reading already determines.
rule.why: measured 2026-11-16 on 130 real pages: the zero-experience reading arm already wins 57 of the 78 pages any demonstration could ever reach (73%), so learning there adds nothing and displaces the reading; and it wins 9 pages exploration never demonstrated at all, so on those reading beats trying outright

board.what_this_is_not: Not a leaderboard entry: the ladder's demonstrations were found with the page's reward visible, which a deployed agent is not given. The reading arm never reads a reward at all.
